name: Lohan (Arhat) Holding a Peach
material: porcelain with famille verte overglaze enamel decoration
summary: Lohan are disciples of Buddha with supernatural powers and eccentric behaviors. This lohan is holding the peach of longevity (shoutao), while its mate is holding the fu-dog, symbolizing good luck.
